---
title: "Movie Analysis"
author: "Angela Davaadorj"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = "/") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre))
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audience_score = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomato_meter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  mutate(genre = factor(genre, levels = genre)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap, y = genre)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = mean_gap > 0), width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Genre Gap Between Critics and Audiences",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate critics favored the genre more than audiences; negative values indicate the reverse.",
    x = "Average Gap (Tomatometer - Audience Score)",
    y = "Genre"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
